specification: N1: source calendar, normalization and independent acceptance

requirements.requirement: Keep source calendar pointer separately from a W3C-normalized Gregorian when value.
Preserve multiple source calendar pointers without multiplying a scalar normalized when.
Versioned TEI W3C profile forbids year zero and preserves negative year lexical evidence; do not infer unsupported conversion.
Diagnose when combined with from or notBefore; no silent precedence.
Retain inclusive day-granularity upper bound, including its final calendar day; no unproved midnight truncation.
Distinguish unknown profile from explicitly selected W3C profile; only the latter supplies its documented normalized calendar.
Reject independently mismatched snapshot identity or revision fence.
Inspect actual preserved old bytes/records and frozen replay after appending a claim revision.
After revocation, actual historical evidence read must obey the current wrapper authorization.
Independently substitute returned witness endpoints into every original constraint.
